APPROVE
The original method is now about 4 in cognitive complexity, the extracted helpers keep the same checks in the same order with the same short-circuit and `locals` side effects (the added `k > 0` is always true since `k ≥ body.Start + 1`), and every helper uses its parameters with the existing `Lexed`/`Span`/`IsConstantSpan` types, so it should build cleanly with warnings as errors.
